items.title: 断联后最先要看的不是对方会不会回来
items.hook: 先看这段沉默正在消耗你什么。
items.body: 把断联拆成事实、感受和边界三层，不用沉默推导承诺。
items.notes: Manual publishing only; no reunion promise

items.title: 想联系 TA 前，先给自己 24 小时
items.hook: 如果你只是想止住焦虑，消息可能会更乱。
items.body: 主动前先问：目的是否清楚，能否接受不回复，有没有留住自己的节奏。
items.cta: 把问题交给天机拆一次
items.notes: Manual publishing only; no pressure tactic

items.title: 断联不是惩罚，也不一定是答案
items.hook: 沉默可能只是信息不足，不是命运宣判。
items.body: 记录互动变化、上一次冲突和自己的底线，不猜心。
items.notes: Manual publishing only; no mind-reading claim

items.title: 真正让你难受的，可能不是没联系
items.hook: 而是不知道下一步该把自己放在哪里。
items.body: 把等消息转成确定自己的下一步，让解读帮你找回节奏。
items.cta: 得到一个更清楚的下一步
items.notes: Manual publishing only; no diagnosis

items.title: 别把每一次忍住都当成失败
items.hook: 暂停也可以是一种保护自己。
items.body: 温和解释边界和节奏，不把克制包装成技巧或博弈。
items.cta: 问清楚这段关系的节奏
items.notes: Manual publishing only; no manipulation advice

items.title: The chat reread loop
items.hook: If one chat decides your mood, zoom out first.
items.body: 15 second script: phone face down, breath, then relationship map; frame Tianji Love as a private mirror, not certainty.
items.notes: Manual publishing only; no private chat screenshot

items.title: Before you send it
items.hook: Pause before anxiety writes the message.
items.body: 20 second script: typed text deleted twice, then one prompt: expression or reassurance seeking?
items.notes: Manual publishing only; no manipulative advice

items.title: Cold reply zoom out
items.hook: A cold reply is data, not a verdict.
items.body: 15 second script: one message is not the whole relationship; map patterns before conclusions.
items.notes: Manual publishing only; no certainty claim

items.title: Maybe is exhausting
items.hook: Living inside maybe can drain your whole day.
items.body: 20 second script: calendar, waiting, then one calm question: what do I actually need to know?
items.notes: Manual publishing only; no diagnosis

items.title: One calmer question
items.hook: A better question creates a better next step.
items.body: 15 second script: turn a spiral into one focused ask.
items.notes: Manual publishing only; no guaranteed answer

items.title: Pattern over panic
items.hook: A single message can hurt. A pattern can teach.
items.body: Short post: Do not let one cold reply write the entire story. Look for context, repair, and your own boundary.
items.notes: Manual publishing only; no perfect accuracy claim

items.title: The unsent message test
items.hook: If the message only exists to reduce anxiety, give it one more hour.
items.body: Short post: A calmer question usually gets you a cleaner next step than a panic message.
items.notes: Manual publishing only; no pressure advice

items.title: Protect your pace
items.hook: You can want clarity and still protect your pace.
items.body: Short post: The goal is not to win the silence. The goal is to stop abandoning yourself inside it.
items.notes: Manual publishing only; no manipulative framing

items.title: When waiting gets loud
items.hook: When waiting gets loud, write the question you actually need answered.
items.body: Short post: Is it timing, trust, effort, or closure? Ask that, not twenty versions of do they care.
items.notes: Manual publishing only; no fake metric

items.title: Clarity is not control
items.hook: Clarity will not control another person. It can steady your next move.
items.body: Short post: Use reflection to choose your boundary, not to force a reply.
items.notes: Manual publishing only; no outcome guarantee

items.title: Should I text after no contact?
items.hook: If you text, make sure it is expression, not panic relief.
items.body: Answer draft: Suggest separating facts from interpretation, writing one clear intention, and accepting that no tool can guarantee a response. Disclose Tianji Love if linking.
items.notes: Manual posting only; disclose affiliation if used

items.title: How do I know if silence means they moved on?
items.hook: You usually cannot know from silence alone.
items.body: Answer draft: Encourage looking at prior consistency, repair attempts, and whether waiting is harming daily life. Avoid mind-reading and reunion promises. Disclose affiliation if linking.
items.notes: Manual posting only; no certainty claim

items.title: I want closure but do not want to chase
items.hook: Closure can start with a cleaner question.
items.body: Answer draft: Offer a simple journaling prompt and optional private question CTA. Keep tone supportive and non-clinical. Disclose affiliation if linking.
items.notes: Manual posting only; no therapeutic claim
